notes.title: Game Launching Soon!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Players,[/b]

We are excited to announce that the game is about to go live on September 18, 2023, at 4 AM EST! Thank you for your continuous support.

[b]Embark on the Adventure Together[/b]

Get ready for an exhilarating journey as we approach this special moment. The game will be launching on Steam, and you can invite your friends to join you in exploring this exciting world.

[b]Thank You for Your Support[/b]

Once again, thank you for your patience and support. We can't wait to meet you in the game and create unforgettable gaming moments together!

[The TTA Team]
